label: prop:vorticity-lower-bound
title: Vorticity lower bound for anti-parallel filament collision as $q \to 1$
html:
Let v^* be the weak limit as q \to 1 of the q-NS solution for anti-parallel vortex pair initial data. Let \omega^* = \nabla \times v^* and let d(t) be the separation between the two filament cores. There exist constants c_1, c_2 > 0 such that for all t < T^*:

  c_1\sqrt{T^* - t} \leq d(t) \leq c_2\sqrt{T^* - t},
  \qquad
  \lVert \omega^*(t) \rVert_{L^\infty} \geq \frac{c_1}{T^* - t},
  \qquad
  \int_0^{T^*} \lVert \omega^*(t) \rVert_{L^\infty}\,dt = +\infty.

These give, respectively, (a) separation decay, (b) a vorticity lower bound, and (c) BKM divergence. In particular, the limit solution v^* loses regularity at T^*.
